name: WA-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbency advantage with no serious opposition
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~97%
model.rationale: The district's +15 Democratic lean, DelBene's incumbency, and an overwhelming financial edge over a minimally funded challenger point to a comfortable double-digit win. Markets price this race as effectively decided.
model.watch: Any late polling or unexpected outside spending against DelBene would be the only signal worth monitoring.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Suzan DelBene seeks another term in a Seattle-area district that leans Democratic by about 15 points. She enters the general election with a large incumbency and fundraising advantage, having raised roughly $3.5 million and holding over $1 million on hand, while Republican Mary Silva has raised under $10,000 with no outside support on either side. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets put DelBene's chances near 97 percent.

The combination of district lean, incumbency, and a lopsided money gap makes an upset highly unlikely. The forecast expects DelBene to win by a wide, low-twenty-point margin, consistent with the district's fundamentals and the absence of any credible challenge infrastructure.
